claim: RayNeo GT firmware reportedly breaks third-party 3DoF tools
summary: October 6 user report (surfaced October 7) says September 22 firmware changed USB descriptor/interface mapping and broke VertoXR, Decky XR Gaming and AirPin integrations while IMU streaming persists. Community-reported, not independently replicated. GT virtual-screen branch is out of the main GlassesResearch model scope; retain as peripheral developer compatibility signal only.
